Finland vs Andorra: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a friendly match where the Finland national team hosts Andorra at the Tampere Stadium. For both teams, who had unsuccessful World Cup qualifying campaigns, this encounter is an opportunity to end the football year on a positive note and test their reserve players.

Kick-off: November 17, 2025, 17:00 UTC (20:00 MSK) Stadium: Tampere Stadium, Tampere Competition: International Friendly

Finland vs Andorra: Match Preview

Both teams approach this match in low spirits. The Finnish national team has suffered five defeats in their last seven games and failed their qualifying campaign, losing heavily to the Netherlands in the final round. The Andorra national team traditionally finishes at the bottom of the tables. In 2025, the team failed to secure a single victory, managing only two draws. The head-to-head history favors the Finns: in two previous matches, they have one win, with the other game ending in a draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Finland

The 'Eagle-owls' will be highly motivated to redeem themselves in front of their home fans after recent setbacks. Despite a general slump, the Finns usually get results against teams of their level or lower. However, the team has serious defensive problems, having failed to keep a clean sheet in their last eight games. In attack, all hopes rest on the experience of veteran Teemu Pukki and the creativity of Glen Kamara.

Andorra

The 'Tricolours' are enduring a prolonged winless streak that has stretched to over ten matches. The team's main issue is their catastrophic attack. In the completed qualifying cycle, Andorra had the worst statistics for both goals scored and goals conceded in their group. In an away match against a motivated opponent, the team is likely to adopt a deep defensive strategy.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Finland (4-3-3): Joronen; Ståhl, Tenho, Koski, Alho; Lod, Kamara, Kairinen; Antman, Pukki, Pohjanpalo.
  • Andorra (5-4-1): Ruiz; Rubio, Llovera, Vales, Guillén, Cervós; Alaez, Rebés, Vieira, Fernández; Sánchez.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the friendly status of the game, Finland is the undisputed favorite. The difference in class, the home-field advantage, and the desire to break their losing streak should be decisive.

  • Main Prediction: Finland to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. The 'Eagle-owls' should comfortably defeat one of Europe's weakest national teams at home to redeem themselves in front of their fans.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of two teams with obvious problems in attack. Given that Andorra will play a deep defensive game and Finland has their own issues with goalscoring, a goal-fest is not expected.

Germany vs Slovakia: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the German national team hosts its main competitor for the top spot in the group, Slovakia. This is a battle between the two group leaders that promises to be uncompromising and tense.

Kick-off: November 17, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Olympiastadion, Berlin Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Germany vs Slovakia: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match as group leaders and main contenders for a direct ticket to the World Cup. Both Germany and Slovakia have had a successful start to the qualifiers, creating a gap from their pursuers. This match is essentially a 'hidden final' for the top spot. Germany, traditionally dominant at home, will be looking to secure three points. Slovakia, meanwhile, is one of the most organized and resilient teams in Europe. The head-to-head history favors Germany, who have won 4 of the last 5 encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Germany

The 'Bundes-team' boasts a wealth of world-class stars in every position. They aim to dominate early, control possession, and constantly pressure the opponent. In attack, a new generation led by Jamal Musiala and Florian Wirtz is shining. Germany will be pushing to secure World Cup qualification early.

Slovakia

The 'Falcons,' led by Francesco Calzona, rely on solid defending and the experience of their top players. Key figures include PSG defender Milan Škriniar and Napoli midfielder Stanislav Lobotka. In attack, Róbert Boženík stands out. Slovakia will try to impose a gritty battle and fight for valuable points.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Germany (4-2-3-1): ter Stegen; Kimmich, Rüdiger, Tah, Raum; Andrich, Kroos; Musiala, Gündoğan, Wirtz; Havertz.
  • Slovakia (4-3-3): Dúbravka; Pekarík, Vavro, Škriniar, Hancko; Kucka, Lobotka, Duda; Suslov, Boženík, Haraslín.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Germany is the favorite in this matchup. The difference in squad quality, home-field advantage, and head-to-head results make a German victory the most likely outcome. It will be extremely difficult for Slovakia to challenge one of the strongest national teams in the world.

  • Main Prediction: Germany to Win. The 'Bundes-team' should confidently defeat their direct rival at home and secure early qualification for the World Cup.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. This is a clash of two attacking sides. Three or more goals were scored in 3 of the last 5 head-to-head matches. A high-scoring match is expected.

Montenegro vs Croatia: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a Balkan derby in the European qualifiers for the 2026 World Cup, where the Montenegro national team hosts one of the group favorites, Croatia, in Podgorica. This is a fierce rivalry between neighbors that promises to be uncompromising.

Kick-off: November 17, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Pod Goricom Stadium, Podgorica Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Montenegro vs Croatia: Match Preview

The teams approach this match with different objectives. The Croatian national team is one of the group leaders and the main contender for a direct ticket to the World Cup. The Montenegrin national team, in turn, is a solid mid-tier side that is capable of challenging any opponent on their home turf, no matter how formidable. The head-to-head history between these teams includes only one official match in the 2022 Nations League, which ended in a draw. The teams also played one friendly match, which Croatia won.

Team Form and Analysis

Montenegro

The 'Brave Falcons,' under Robert Prosinečki, rely on a solid defense and the experience of their leaders. At home, with the support of their passionate fans, the Montenegrins play with particular dedication. The team will aim to impose a gritty, tough battle and use their chances on the counter-attack. The team's leaders are captain Stevan Jovetić and Atlético Madrid defender Stefan Savić.

Croatia

The 'Vatreni' (The Blazers), under Zlatko Dalić, boast one of the strongest squads in Europe with incredible experience and class. The team will rely on total ball control and the high individual skill of its leaders - Luka Modrić, Mateo Kovačić, and Andrej Kramarić. The Croatians will be looking to secure three points to strengthen their lead in the group.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Montenegro (4-4-2): Mijatović; Vujačić, Rubežić, Tomašević, Radунović; Vukčević, Janković, Bakić, Camaj; Jovetić, Krstović.
  • Croatia (4-3-3): Livaković; Stanišić, Šutало, Gvardiol, Sosa; Modrić, Brozović, Kovačić; Majer, Kramarić, Perišić.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Croatia is the clear favorite, the trip to Podgorica is never an easy ride. Montenegro, as hosts and in a heated derby, is capable of taking points from any giant.

  • Main Prediction: Croatia to Win. Despite all the difficulties, the class and individual skill of the Croatian stars should be the deciding factor.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Montenegro will play a closed style of football, packing their defense. It will not be easy for the Croatians to create chances. Both previous head-to-head meetings were low-scoring. A tight contest with a small number of goals is expected.

Malta vs Poland: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Malta national team hosts one of the group favorites, Poland, at the National Stadium in Ta' Qali. This is a meeting between one of the underdogs and a team fighting for a spot at the World Cup.

Kick-off: November 17, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: National Stadium, Ta' Qali Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Malta vs Poland: Match Preview

The teams approach this match with different objectives. The Polish national team is one of the main contenders for qualification from the group and will be looking to secure three points to strengthen their position. The Malta national team, on the other hand, is one of the underdogs and is playing for pride. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Poles, who have won all seven previous encounters with a combined score of 28-2.

Team Form and Analysis

Malta

The 'Knights of St. John' are having a disastrous qualifying campaign, having failed to secure a single victory and conceding the most goals in the group. The team is experiencing serious problems in both defense and attack. It will be extremely difficult for the Maltese to hope for a positive result in a home match against one of Europe's strongest national teams. The team is likely to adopt a deep defensive strategy.

Poland

The 'White Eagles,' after a less than ideal start, have gained good momentum and are in the hunt for a direct ticket to the World Cup. The team relies on the experience of its leaders, with the legendary Barcelona striker Robert Lewandowski playing a key role. The Poles will aim to dominate from the first minutes and try to score an early goal to avoid a nervy finish.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Malta (5-4-1): Bonello; Mbong, Shaw, Pepe, Borg, Camenzuli; Teuma, Guillaumier, Muscat, Jones; Satariano.
  • Poland (3-5-2): Szczęsny; Bednarek, Dawidowicz, Kiwior; Frankowski, Slisz, Zieliński, Szymański, Zalewski; Świderski, Lewandowski.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Poland is the absolute favorite for this contest. The difference in class, current form, and head-to-head statistics make a victory for the Poles almost a foregone conclusion. It will be extremely difficult for Malta to offer any resistance to the motivated visitors.

  • Main Prediction: Poland to Win with a (-2) Handicap. One of the strongest teams in the group should comfortably defeat the underdog to prove their ambitions for direct qualification.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Poland to Win to Nil. In 5 of the last 7 head-to-head meetings, Malta failed to score against the Poles. Given the difference in class, the 'White Eagles' are likely to prevent their opponent from scoring.

Netherlands vs Lithuania: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where one of the favorites of Group G, the Netherlands national team, hosts the Lithuanian national team at the Johan Cruyff Arena in Amsterdam. For the hosts, this match is a formality on their way to the World Cup, while for the visitors, it's another tough test.

Kick-off: November 17, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Johan Cruyff Arena, Amsterdam Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Netherlands vs Lithuania: Match Preview

The teams approach this match with completely different objectives. The Netherlands national team has practically secured its spot at the World Cup, confidently leading the group. The Lithuanian national team, in turn, is one of the underdogs, having failed to earn a single point and sitting at the bottom of the table. The 'Oranje' are in magnificent form, displaying a high-scoring brand of football. The Lithuanian team has had a disastrous qualifying campaign, suffering defeats in all matches and conceding 17 goals in six games. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Netherlands, who have won all three previous encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Netherlands

Ronald Koeman's side is playing some of the most prolific football in the qualifiers, having scored 22 goals. The 'Oranje' attack, led by Memphis Depay, is in phenomenal form. At home, the Dutch are particularly formidable. In this match, the coaching staff will likely rotate the squad, giving young talents a chance to shine, but even with rotation, the Netherlands remain significantly stronger than their opponent.

Lithuania

The Lithuanian team, led by Edgaras Jankauskas, is struggling with major issues both in defense and attack. The squad has conceded 17 goals and scored only once. In an away match against one of the strongest attacks in Europe, Lithuania can only hope for a miracle and that the opponent plays below their usual level. A deep defensive strategy is expected.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Netherlands (3-4-3): Verbruggen; de Ligt, van Dijk, Aké; Dumfries, Koopmeiners, de Jong, Hartman; Simons, Weghorst, Gakpo.
  • Lithuania (5-4-1): Gertmonas; Lasickas, Lekiatas, Girdvainis, Kažukolovas, Sirvys; Slivka, Gineitis, Utkus, Černych; Paulauskas.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

There is virtually no intrigue in this match. The difference in class, form, and motivation is enormous. The only real question is how many goals the Netherlands will score.

  • Main Prediction: Netherlands to Win with a (-3.5) Handicap. The 'Oranje' should have no trouble at home against one of the weakest teams in the qualifiers and will likely earn a convincing victory.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Netherlands' Individual Total Over 3.5 Goals. Given Lithuania's defensive struggles and the attacking firepower of the Dutch side, a high-scoring performance from the hosts is expected.

Northern Ireland vs Luxembourg: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Northern Ireland national team hosts its direct competitor for a top spot, the Luxembourg national team, at Windsor Park in Belfast. This is a 'six-pointer' for the two 'dark horses' of the group.

Kick-off: November 17, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Windsor Park, Belfast Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Northern Ireland vs Luxembourg: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match needing to pick up points to keep their chances of qualifying from the group alive. The Luxembourg national team has made incredible progress in recent years and is no longer a 'minnow,' having transformed into a solid mid-tier side capable of taking points from any opponent. Northern Ireland, in turn, is undergoing a generational change but is traditionally resilient at home with the support of their fans. The head-to-head history between these teams is balanced: in four matches, each team has one win, with two games ending in a draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Northern Ireland

The 'Green and White Army' is known for its British style, fighting spirit, and skill from set pieces. At home, the team will rely on physical football and high pressing. Despite the lack of world-class stars, the team is strong in its organization and commitment.

Luxembourg

The 'Red Lions,' under coach Luc Holtz, are experiencing the most successful period in their history. The team relies on an organized defense, commitment, and fast counter-attacks. The team's leaders are Gerson Rodrigues and the Barreiro brothers. In the match against the physical Northern Irish, Luxembourg will try to impose its game and fight for points.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Northern Ireland (5-3-2): Peacock-Farrell; Hume, Ballard, Evans, Brown, Lewis; McNair, Charles, Thompson; Price, Washington.
  • Luxembourg (5-3-2): Moris; Bohnert, Mahmutovic, Chanot, Carlson, Pinto; Barreiro, Martins, Olesen; Rodrigues, Sinani.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A match between two teams of equal strength and ambition is extremely difficult to predict. Northern Ireland has the home-field advantage, but Luxembourg is on the rise and has shown more consistent results recently.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. In a clash between two direct competitors, where the cost of a mistake is very high, a draw seems the most likely outcome. Both teams will primarily focus on not losing.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of two teams that focus on defense. 3 of the last 4 head-to-head meetings have been low-scoring. A tight contest with a small number of goals is expected.

events.dataContent:
Czech Republic vs Gibraltar: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Czech Republic national team hosts one of European football's main underdogs, the Gibraltar national team, in Prague. For the hosts, this match is an opportunity to secure a big win and improve their goal difference, while for the visitors, it's another tough test of their resilience.

Kick-off: November 17, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Epet Arena, Prague Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Czech Republic vs Gibraltar: Match Preview

The teams approach this match with diametrically opposite objectives. The Czech Republic is one of the contenders for qualification from the group and will be looking to take three points with the largest possible scoreline. The Gibraltar national team traditionally finishes at the bottom of the tables, having failed to earn a single point and conceding the most goals in the group. This will be the first-ever official meeting between these national teams, which, however, hardly adds any intrigue.

Team Form and Analysis

Czech Republic

The 'National Team,' under coach Ivan Hašek, will dominate from the first to the last minute. The Czechs boast a wealth of players from Europe's top 5 leagues, with West Ham leaders Tomáš Souček and Vladimír Coufal, as well as the main striking force, Patrik Schick from Bayer Leverkusen, standing out. Against one of the weakest participants in the qualifiers, the coaching staff may opt for rotation, but even the Czech second string is several goals stronger than their opponent.

Gibraltar

The Gibraltar national team consists mainly of semi-professional footballers. The team's main task in such matches is to avoid a heavy defeat and, if they get lucky, try to score a consolation goal. 'Team 54' will set up a deep, layered defense and will be hoping for commitment and a bit of luck.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Czech Republic (3-4-3): Staněk; Holeš, Hranáč, Krejčí; Coufal, Souček, Provod, Jurásek; Hložek, Schick, Kuchta.
  • Gibraltar (5-4-1): Coeling; Sergeant, Olivero, Chipolina, Hartman, Britto; Walker, Pozo, Annesley, Ronan; De Barr.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The intrigue in this match is not about who will win, but about how many goals the Czech Republic will score. The difference in class between high-level professionals and amateurs is too vast.

  • Main Prediction: Czech Republic to Win with a (-4.5) Handicap. The Czechs should have no problems at home and will likely secure a very large victory against one of European football's main underdogs.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Czech Republic's Individual Total Over 4.5 Goals. Given Gibraltar's catastrophic defense and the attacking power of the Czechs, a large number of goals from the home side can be expected.
